armySpecialRules.name: Ambush From The Worldroots
armySpecialRules.description:
A Wood Elf army can always place an additional forest
no more than 12" in diameter on the battlefield. This is
done during deployment, before any units are
deployed, and must be placed wholly in your half of
the battlefield. Declare which type of forest it is when
you place it. If you cannot fit the forest on your half of
the table, move other terrain features by the shortest
distance necessary so that the forest can be placed. If
you still cannot place the forest, or if the scenario
means that the Wood Elf army does not have a table
half in which to deploy, this additional forest is not
used in this battle.

armySpecialRules.name: Asrai Archery
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule do not suffer the normal
-1 To Hit penalty for moving and shooting.

armySpecialRules.name: Blessings Of The Ancients
armySpecialRules.description:
A Wizard that has this rule and is within 6" of a forest
gains a +1 casting and dispel bonus.

armySpecialRules.name: Elven Shortbow
armySpecialRules.description:
Elven shortbows have the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
16/24" 3 Armour Piercing (1),
March & Shoot,
Multiple Shots (2)*,
Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not marched.
Cannot be used as a charge reaction

armySpecialRules.name: Elven Longbow
armySpecialRules.description:
Elven longbows have the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
24/36" 3 Armour Piercing (1),
Multiple Shots (2)*,
Volley Fire
*Only applies in turns the model has not moved.
Cannot be used as a charge reaction.

armySpecialRules.name: Elven Grace
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule have the Dodge (6+) special rule
in close combat. However, this cannot be used against
enemies that attack before the model with Elven Grace.

armySpecialRules.name: Enchanted Arrows
armySpecialRules.description:
Some models in the Wood Elf army have the option to
purchase enchanted arrows. If a model has enchanted
arrows, they must use them when shooting with Elven
shortbows or longbows. Note that a model can only
have one kind of Enchanted Arrows.
• Arcane Bodkins: Shooting attacks made with
Arcane Bodkins have the Armour Piercing (1) special
rule.
• Hagbane Tips: Shooting attacks made with Hagbane
Tips have the Poisoned Attacks special rule.
• Moonfire Shot: Shooting attacks made with
Moonfire Shot have the Flaming Attacks and
Magical Attacks special rules.
• Starfire Shafts: Shooting attacks made with Starfire
Shafts have the Magical Attacks special rule and
force enemies to re-roll successful Panic tests caused
by Heavy Casualties.
• Swiftshiver Shards: Shooting attacks made with
Swiftshiver Shards allow the model to fire Multiple
Shots even when moving (in case of longbows) or
marching (in case of shortbows) that turn.
• Trueflight Arrows: Shooting attacks made with
Trueflight Arrows ignore all shooting modifiers that
are not caused by magic items or spells.

armySpecialRules.name: Forest Spirit
armySpecialRules.description:
A model with this rule has the Fear, Forest Strider,
Immunity (Psychology), Magical Attacks and Magical
Ward (5+) special rules. However, units of Forest
Spirits may only be joined by characters that are also
Forest Spirits and vice versa.

armySpecialRules.name: Forest Stalker
armySpecialRules.description:
While inside a wood, models with this special rule are
at an additional -1 to be Hit with missile attacks. In
addition, when using the Scouts special rule they may
deploy within 12" of an enemy unit if they do so within
a wood.

armySpecialRules.name: Lethal Shot
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule have the Killing Blow special
rule with missile attacks from their Elven longbows or
shortbows.

armySpecialRules.name: Martial Memories
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule may re-roll 1's when rolling To
Hit and To Wound in close combat.

armySpecialRules.name: Saearath
armySpecialRules.description:
Spear. Unless used with a shield in combat or when
using the Mighty Blow (1) special rule from the
weapon, a model armed with a saerath gains +1 Attack.

armySpecialRules.name: Shadow Dances Of Loec
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule may choose one of the following
Shadow Dances at the start of each round of close
combat. This is done before Impact Hits are resolved.
All models in the same unit must choose the same
Shadow Dance. The effect of each Shadow Dance lasts
until the end of that turn or until a new Shadow Dance
is chosen. Models cannot choose the same Shadow
Dance in two consecutive rounds of combat.
• Whirling Death: The model gains the Armour
Piercing (1) and Killing Blow special rules.
• Storm of Blades: The model gains +1 Attack.
• The Shadows Coil: All close combat attacks against
the model suffer -1 To Hit.
• Woven Mist: The model gains the Always Strikes
First special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: Tree Aspects
armySpecialRules.description:
Models with this rule may choose one of the following
Tree Aspects at the start of each round of close combat.
This is done before Impact Hits are resolved. All
models in the same unit must choose the same Tree
Aspect. The effect of each Tree Aspect lasts until the
end of that turn or until a new Tree Aspect is chosen.
Models cannot choose the same Tree Aspect in two
consecutive rounds of combat.
• Birch Aspect: The model gains +1 Attack.
• Oak Aspect: The model gains +1 Toughness.
• Willow Aspect: All close combat attacks against the
model suffer -1 To Hit.

armySpecialRules.name: Tree Whack
armySpecialRules.description:
A model with this rule can choose to make a single
Tree Whack in place of making their normal close
combat attacks. To resolve a Tree Whack, nominate an
enemy model in base contact. That model must pass an
Initiative test or suffer D6 Wounds which Ignores
Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: The Spirit Sword
magicItems.description:
Armour saves cannot be taken against Wounds caused
by the Spirit Sword. Furthermore, immediately when
an enemy single model unit or Character suffers one or
more unsaved Wounds from the Spirit Sword, both they
and the wielder must roll 2D6 and add their respective
Leadership values. If the wounded model's total is
higher, or the totals are the same, nothing else happens.
If the wounded model's total is lower, it immediately
suffers a Wound which Ignores Armour Saves for each
point by which its total was exceeded.

magicItems.name: Daith'S Reaper
magicItems.description:
All failed To Hit and To Wound rolls made with Daith's
Reaper must be re-rolled, as must all successful armour
saves taken against Wounds caused by this weapon.

magicItems.name: Dawnspear
magicItems.description:
Light lance/spear. If the wielder of the Dawnspear
causes an unsaved wound on an enemy, then all enemy
models in that unit that have not yet attacked suffer -1
To Hit in this round of close combat.

magicItems.name: Callach'S Claw
magicItems.description:
Any unit suffering one or more unsaved wounds from
the Callach's Claw suffers a -2 penalty to their
Leadership for the remainder of the Combat phase.

magicItems.name: The Hunter'S Talon
magicItems.description:
Elven longbow. The Hunter's Talon gives the wielder
the Sniper special rule.

magicItems.name: Spear Of Daith
magicItems.description:
Light lance/spear. The Spear of Daith gives the wielder
the Parry (5+) special rule.

magicItems.name: The Bow Of Loren
magicItems.description:
Elven longbow. All shots from the Bow of Loren are
resolved at Strength 4 with Multiple Shots (A) special
rule. Multiple Shots (A) means the bow fires a number
of shots equal to the wielder's Attacks characteristic. It
cannot fire enchanted arrows.

magicItems.name: Blades Of Loec
magicItems.description:
Shadowdancer only. Two hand weapons. The Blades of
Loec allow the wielder to re-roll failed rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: Greenwood Gladius
magicItems.description:
The wielder of this item gains +D3 Attacks, rolled at
the start of each round of close combat.
c and powerful magical artefacts used by the Wood
found in the Warhammer rulebook.

magicItems.name: Hunt Master'S Pride
magicItems.description:
Wild Hunter only. Light lance. All attacks with this
weapon have the Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule.

magicItems.name: Spear Of Twilight
magicItems.description:
Light lance/spear. The Spear of Twilight gives the
wielder the Killing Blow special rule.

magicItems.name: Sword Of A Thousand Winters
magicItems.description:
The Sword of a Thousand Winters gives the bearer the
Ice Attacks special rule. In addition, Characters and
Monsters must take a Toughness test for each unsaved
wound suffered by the Sword of a Thousand Winters.
For every test failed, they suffer -1 Strength, Initiative
and Attacks for the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: Vaul'S Wrath
magicItems.description:
Elven longbow. This weapon has the following profile:
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
24/36" 4 Armour Piercing (1),
Multiple Shots (2),
Multiple Wounds (2)
Volley Fire

magicItems.name: Spear Of The Hunt
magicItems.description:
Wild Hunter only. Light lance. This item gives the
wielder the Armour Piercing (1) special rule. In
addition, they and any unit they are with may re-roll 1's
for their charge distance.

magicItems.name: Splinterbirch Blade
magicItems.description:
Whenever an enemy model makes a successful save
against Wounds caused by this blade, they suffer an
additional D6 Strength 1 Hits.

magicItems.name: Starcaster Longbow
magicItems.description:
Elven longbow. All shots from this bow have the
Multiple Wounds (D3) special rule. On a To Wound roll
of a natural 6, that shot has the Multiple Wounds (D6)
special rule instead.

magicItems.name: Asyendi'S Bane
magicItems.description:
Elven longbow. This weapon allows the wielder to re-
roll all failed rolls To Hit. However, if the shot still
misses after this re-roll, then they suffer a Strength 3
hit.

magicItems.name: Rageth'S Wildfire Blades
magicItems.description:
Two hand weapons. Rageth's Wildfire Blades give the
wielder the Flaming Attacks special rule.

magicItems.name: Armour Of The Fey
magicItems.description:
Light armour. The Armour of the Fey gives the bearer
the Magical Ward (4+) special rule against Magical
Attacks.

magicItems.name: The Oaken Armour
magicItems.description:
Light armour. The Oaken Armour gives the wearer the
Regeneration (4+) special rule.

magicItems.name: Cloak Of Tumbling Leaves
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. Light armour. The bearer's gains
the Fly (10) special rule.

magicItems.name: Briarsheath
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. Light armour. The Briarsheath
causes any missile attacks targeted at the wearer to
suffer -1 To Hit, or -2 To Hit if the wearer is in a forest.

magicItems.name: The Helm Of The Hunt
magicItems.description:
Wild Hunter only. This item gives the wearer a 6+
armour save. In addition, they may re-roll To Hit in
turns that they successfully charge into combat.

magicItems.name: Railarian'S Mantle
magicItems.description:
Light armour. Railarian's Mantle gives the wearer a
Magical Ward (5+) if they are within 6" of a forest.

magicItems.name: Amber Armour
magicItems.description:
Light armour. The bearer's armour save can never be
reduced below a 6+.

magicItems.name: Rhymer'S Harp
magicItems.description:
The Rhymer's Harp gives the bearer and any unit they
join the Magical Ward (5+) and Strider special rules.

magicItems.name: Glamourweave Brooch
magicItems.description:
The Glamourweave Brooch gives the bearer the
Magical Ward (4+) special rule against missile attacks.
In addition, any model attempting to strike the bearer
in close combat must first pass a Leadership test or
require 6's To Hit the bearer during that Combat phase.

magicItems.name: Amaranthine Brooch
magicItems.description:
The Amaranthine Brooch gives the wearer the Magical
Ward (4+) special rule against non-Magical Attacks.

magicItems.name: Stone Of The Crystal Mere
magicItems.description:
The Stone of the Crystal Mere gives the bearer the
Magical Ward (3+) special rule. However, if this Ward
Save is ever failed, the Magical Ward is lost for the rest
of the game.

magicItems.name: Amber Pendant
magicItems.description:
The Amber Pendant causes all enemy units in base
contact with the wearer to be subject to the Always
Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: Fimbulwinter Shard
magicItems.description:
The Fimbulwinter Shard causes enemies attacking the
bearer in close combat to suffer -1 To Hit. However, all
models with the Forest Spirit special rule (including the
bearer) suffer from Stupidity while the bearer is within
6".

magicItems.name: Talisman Of Qwarr
magicItems.description:
Models targeting the bearer with missile attacks must
re-roll successful rolls To Hit.

magicItems.name: Stone Of Rebirth
magicItems.description:
One use only. If the bearer of the Stone of Rebirth is
killed, roll a D6. On a 2+, the model is brought back to
life with one Wound remaining. This has no effect if
the wearer was killed as a result of being pursued
down.

magicItems.name: Merciw'S Locus
magicItems.description:
Merciw's Locus causes the bearer and any model
attacking them to lose all Strength bonuses from any
weapon they might carry.

magicItems.name: Deepmire Cloak
magicItems.description:
Model on foot only. If the wearer is in cover and is at
their starting number of Wounds, enemy missile attacks
targeting them suffer -1 To Hit. If the wearer is in cover
and has suffered one or more Wounds during the game,
they cannot be targeted by missile attacks at all.

magicItems.name: Orb Of Midsummer
magicItems.description:
Relic. The bearer of this item may re-roll failed casting
attempts, unless a Miscast has been rolled.

magicItems.name: Ranu'S Heartstione
magicItems.description:
Relic. Once per Magic phase, the bearer of this item
may re-roll one of the dice when casting or dispelling a
spell. This can be used to prevent a miscast or to cause
Ultimate Power.

magicItems.name: Vesperal Gem
magicItems.description:
Charm. One use only. This item can be used at the start
of your Magic phase. Once used, the Wizard can
automatically cast any one of their spells from the Lore
of Athel Loren without using any power dice this turn.
This spell cannot be dispelled. After resolving the
effects of the spell, roll a D6. On a 1, the bearer suffers
1 Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: Oaken Stave
magicItems.description:
Staff. The bearer of this item may roll an extra D6
when dispelling and discard the lowest result.

magicItems.name: Silverwood Circlet
magicItems.description:
Relic. The bearer of this item adds +12" to the range of
all their spells (excluding auras).

magicItems.name: Viridescent Shawl
magicItems.description:
Relic. This item gives the bearer a +1 casting bonus. In
addition, all enemy missile attacks targeting the bearer
suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: Divination Orb
magicItems.description:
Relic. If an opponent uses more than three power dice
(from any source) when casting any spell, the bearer of
the Divination Orb may add an extra free Dispel dice
into the attempt to dispel that spell.

magicItems.name: Deepwood Sphere
magicItems.description:
Relic. Any enemy unit that enters a forest within 18" of
the bearer of the Deepwood Sphere suffers D6 Strength
4 Hits as soon as they have finished their move. They
continue to suffer D6 Strength 4 Hits at the start of any
of their Movement phases for as long as they remain in
the forest and the bearer of the item remains within
range.

magicItems.name: Elf Charm
magicItems.description:
Relic. When casting spells from the Lore of Life, the
wizard may add a +D3 casting bonus once per Magic
phase.

magicItems.name: Calaingor'S Stave
magicItems.description:
Staff. When casting the Tree Singing spell from the
Lore of Athel Loren, the bearer may re-roll the distance
the forest moves.

magicItems.name: Heartwood Pendant
magicItems.description:
Relic. The bearer of this item may choose their spells
from the Lore of Athel Loren in addition to one other
spell lore.

magicItems.name: Warsong Stave
magicItems.description:
Staff. The bearer of this item knows the Tree Singing
spell from the Lore of Athel Loren in addition to their
other spells.

magicItems.name: Wending Wand
magicItems.description:
Staff. Any friendly unit that pursued off the table can
enter the table from any point of any table edge of their
choice in their next turn, as long as it is within 24" of
the bearer of this item.
SIGIL OF THE MAGE QUEEN* 5 points
Charm. One use only. This item may be used after
making a casting roll. When used, it adds a +3 casting
bonus.
magicItems.restriction:
Staff. Any friendly unit that pursued off the table can
enter the table from any point of any table edge of their
choice in their next turn, as long as it is within 24" of
the bearer of this item.
SIGIL OF THE MAGE QUEEN* 5 points
Charm. One use only.

magicItems.name: Crown Of Fell Bowers
magicItems.description:
The wearer and any unit they are with gain +1 To
Wound in close combat.

magicItems.name: Wardroth Horn
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item may be used at the start of any
close combat phase. Once used, all friendly units
(excluding mounts) within 12" gain +1 Attack for the
duration of this turn.

magicItems.name: Moonstone Of The Hidden Ways
magicItems.description:
If the bearer's unit is wholly within a forest at the end
of your Movement phase, and is not in close combat, it
can forestwalk. If it does so, remove it from the
battlefield and immediately replace it, wholly within
any forest on the battlefield, just like a summoning
spell. A unit that forestwalks counts as having marched
in the Movement phase.

magicItems.name: Hail Of Doom Arrow
magicItems.description:
One use only. Model with Elven longbow only. The
Hail of Doom arrow can be used instead of making a
Shooting attack with the bearer's Elven longbow,
though it cannot be used with the Sniper rule. Declare
that the Hail of Doom Arrow is being used before any
dice are rolled.
Range: Strength: Special Rules:
24/36" 4 Multiple Shots (3D6)

magicItems.name: Forget-Me-Knot
magicItems.description:
One use only. This item can be used against one enemy
model in base contact at the start of any round of close
combat. For the duration of that round, the target may
not Attack or Stomp.

magicItems.name: Horn Of The Asrai
magicItems.description:
One use only. The Horn of the Asrai can be used at the
beginning of any enemy Movement phase. When used,
all enemies able to declare a charge against the bearer
of this item must take a Psychology test. If they fail,
they must declare a charge against the bearer this turn.

magicItems.name: Waystalker'S Cloak
magicItems.description:
The Waystalker's Cloak gives the wearer the Forest
Stalker and Scouts special rules.

magicItems.name: Wraithstone
magicItems.description:
All enemy units within 6" of the bearer of the
Wraithstone suffer a -1 penalty to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: Elynett'S Brooch
magicItems.description:
Elynett's Brooch allows the wearer and any unit they
are with to re-roll failed Psychology tests.
WAILING ARROWS* 15 points
Enchanted Arrows. Any unit that suffers an unsaved
wound from these arrows must make a Panic test.
ARROWS OF POTENCY* 10 points
Enchanted Arrows. Any shots made with the Arrows of
Potency have the Multiple Wounds (2) special rule.
BLIGHT-TIPPED ARROWS* 10 points
Enchanted Arrows. Any Character, Monstrous Creature
or Monster that suffers an unsaved Wound by Blight-
Tipped Arrows must pass a Toughness test at the start
of each turn for the remainder of the game or suffer an
additional Wound which Ignores Armour Saves.

magicItems.name: Crown Of Antlers
magicItems.description:
The bearer of this item gains the Impact Hits (D3)
special rule. The Impact Hits are Armour Piercing (1).
ORION'S FAVOUR* 10 points
One use only. The bearer can re-roll any failed rolls To
Hit and/or To Wound made during either the Shooting
or Close Combat phase.
magicItems.restriction:
The bearer of this item gains the Impact Hits (D3)
special rule. The Impact Hits are Armour Piercing (1).
ORION'S FAVOUR* 10 points
One use only.

magicItems.name: Gwytherc'S Horn
magicItems.description:
All friendly units within 12" of the bearer of
Gwytherc's Horn gain +1 to their Leadership when
attempting to Rally.
DRAGONTOOTH ARROWS* 5 points
Enchanted Arrows. Any Character, Monstrous Creature
or Monster that suffers an unsaved Wound by
Dragontooth Arrows gains the Stupidity special rule for
the remainder of the game.

magicItems.name: Battle Standard Of Athel Loren
magicItems.description:
Whenever an enemy spell is cast at a friendly unit
within 12" of this standard, roll a D6; on a 5+, the spell
is automatically dispelled.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Wildwood
magicItems.description:
All enemy units with Line of Sight to this banner suffer
-1 to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Eternal Queen
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard has the Magic
Resistance (3) special rule. In addition, it gains +1
combat resolution bonus if it is within 6" of a forest.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Hunter King
magicItems.description:
Wild Riders only. The unit carrying this standard add
+D6" to their charge range.

magicItems.name: Gaemrath, The Banner Of Midwinter
magicItems.description:
One use only. Gaemrath, the Banner of Midwinter may
be used at the start of any close combat phase. Until the
start of your next Movement phase, the unit carrying
the banner may not move and gains the Unbreakable
special rule.

magicItems.name: Faoghir, The Banner Of Dwindling
magicItems.description:
Enemies that attempt to charge or flee from the unit
carrying Faoghir, the Banner of Dwindling roll one
dice fewer than normal to determine their charge/flee
distance.

magicItems.name: Saemrath, The Banner Of Zenith
magicItems.description:
Enemy units within 12" of the unit carrying Saemrath,
the Banner of the Zenith at the start of their Movement
phase may not March.

magicItems.name: Standard Of Morning'S Chill
magicItems.description:
All missile attacks targeting the unit carrying this
standard suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: Tapestry Of Talsyn
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard gains the Hold Your
Ground (6) special rule.

magicItems.name: Banner Of The Wild Hunt
magicItems.description:
Wild Riders only. The unit carrying this standard gains
+1 Combat Resolution and may re-roll failed pursuit
rolls.

magicItems.name: Aech, The Banner Of Springtide
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying Aech, the Banner of Springtide gains
the Quick Shot special rule and may fire Multiple Shots
with their bows when choosing Stand & Shoot as a
charge reaction.

magicItems.name: Banner Of Midsummer'S Eve
magicItems.description:
The unit carrying this standard ignores To Hit penalties
for shooting at enemies in cover.

successfully cast, all enemy units suffer a -3" penalty to
their spell and maximum weapon ranges in their next
turn when targeting any friendly units within 6" of the
Wizard. This is a cumulative effect.
